text: What'll it be, captain? Pistols, blades, shot, rope, rum. If it floats or fights, I've got it.
{npc}, at your service. Good stock today, fresh off the boats.
Looking to spend some doubloons? You've come to the right counter.
Keep your voice down. There are marines about, and your face is on the posters.
I'll serve you, but quickly. Bounty hunters drink in here.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Where does your stock come from?
Any advice for a new captain?

text: Kingsport ironworks, Saltmarrow rope-walks, and the odd wreck. Don't ask which wreck.
Wherever the boats bring it. This week, mostly from a ship that won't be needing it anymore.
Pistol shot, always. Planks, since the ghost ships started showing up. Map fragments, if you can believe it.
Keep planks in the hold for patching. Keep shot in your pockets. Keep your crew paid.
And never, ever sail past Hollowgrave at night with your sails furled.
